findings.text: The company's status is recorded as active.
Companies House holds no insolvency record for this company.
Accounts are not overdue; the next accounts are due 26 August 2027, and the last accounts were made up to 28 February 2026.
The confirmation statement is not overdue; it was last made up to 18 June 2026 and the next is due 2 July 2027.
Of 9 registered charges, 2 are outstanding, 0 are part-satisfied and 7 are satisfied.
There are 11 current officers, comprising 10 directors and 1 other officer.

Across 5 of the 10 current directors checked, 83 other companies were found, including 1 liquidation, and the directors' links to a company in an insolvency process are flagged as a low-level red flag.
No current person with significant control is on record, which does not prove the company has no owner.
Between 24 October 2025 and the search date, no registered office address changes were filed, and 1 director, PERSON 037, resigned on 6 May 2026.

headline.text: TESCO PLC (00445790) is an active company incorporated on 27 November 1947, with accounts and confirmation statement not overdue, 2 outstanding charges and no insolvency record held.
